data.title: 时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟
data.description: 【时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟】破败的断壁残垣与悬停在半空的碎石尘埃被静止的时间彻底冻结。狂三撑着黑色蕾丝遮阳伞漫步在灰白废墟中，宛如游览私家花园般从容，向你投来神秘莫测的笑容——「在属于我的时间领域里，万物皆已停滞。唯有我和你的心跳声，依然在此处回响呢。」
data.action: 行走在静止时间中的废墟街道
data.promptProse: Kurumi takes a measured step beneath an open black lace parasol through the frozen debris of a ruined city street. Her black-and-crimson dress moves while masonry fragments remain suspended around a clear path. The wide view shows her whole figure against receding broken archways. Cool night light separates the pale stone planes; a small golden clock behind her shoulder locally warms her sleeve and the nearest fragment as she smiles composedly.
